title: Dua Simaat
introduction:
DUA SIMAT

The Supplication of the Attributes.

This supplication is also called Dua al-Shubur. It is advisable to say this supplication at the last hour of Fridays. It is well-known that Dua al-Simat is one of the famous supplications, which was regularly said by the past scholars. This supplication is recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid, Sayyid Ibn Tawus’s book of Jamal al-Usbu’, and al-Kaf’ami’s books through an authentic series of narrators on the authority of Muhammad ibn ‘Uthman al-’Umari, one of the Four Envoys of Imam al-Mahdi, peace be upon him. The supplication has been also reported from Imam Muhammad al-Baqir and Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq, peace be upon them. With commentary, al-Majlisi has also narrated the supplication in his famous book of Bihar al-Anwar. The following form is quoted from Shaykh al-Tusi’s Misbah al-Mutahajjid:

You may now beseech Almighty Allah to grant you your personal requests. Then, say the following:

According to some copies of the supplication, the following statement is added before the latter portion:

You may now beseech Almighty Allah to grant you your personal requests. Then, say the following:

Shaykh al-Majlisi has quoted Sayyid Ibn Baqi as saying, in al-Misbah, that the following supplicatory prayer is advisably said after Dua al-Simat:

You may then mention your need and continue as follows:

You may here mention the name of your enemy

You may then say the following:

Shaykh Ibn Fahad says that it is recommended to say the following prayer after Dua al-Simat:

You may now mention your personal needs.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيْمِ الْاَعْظَمِ
verses.translation: O Allah, I beseech You by Your Name, the most great, most majestic,
most magnificent, and most noble;

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْ اِذَا دُعِيْتَ بِهِ عَلىٰ مَغَالِقِ اَبْوَابِ السَّماۤءِ لِلْفَتْحِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ انْفَتَحَتْ،
verses.translation: if You are besought thereby to open the closed doors of the sky, they will be opened with Your mercy,

verses.arabic: وَ اِذَا دُعِيْتَ بِهِ عَلىٰ مَضَاۤئِقِ اَبْوَابِ الْاَرْضِ لِلْفَرَجِ انْفَرَجَتْ
verses.translation: if You are besought thereby to remove the narrow doors of the heavens for relief, they will be opened wide,

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا دُعِيْتَ بِهِ عَلىٰ العُسْرِ لِلْيُسْرِ تَيَسَّرَتْ
verses.translation: if You are besought thereby to make easy the difficulty, it will be easy,

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا دُعِيْتَ بِهِ عَلىٰ الْاَمْوَاتِ لِلنُّشُوْرِ انْتَشَرَتْ
verses.translation: if You are besought thereby to restore the dead to life, they will rise from their graves,

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا دُعِيْتَ بِهِ عَلىٰ كَشْفِ الْبَأْساۤءِ وَالضَّرَّاۤءِ انْكَشَفَتْ
verses.translation: if You are besought thereby to remove misery and adversity, they will be removed.
I also beseech You in the name of the Majesty of Your Noble Face;
the Noblest and most Honored of all faces
before Whom all faces bow down in submission,
all necks bend down in reverence,
all sounds yield,

verses.arabic: وَ وَجِلَتْ لَهُ الْقُلُوْبُ مِنْ مَخَافَتِكَ،
verses.translation: and all hearts tremble out of fear of You.
I also beseech You by Your Might

verses.arabic: تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاۤءَ اَنْ تَقَعَ عَلىٰ الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِكَ،
verses.translation: by which You prevent the sky from falling on the earthexcept with Your permission,
and control the heavens and the earth so closely that they cannot move away from their positions,
by Your Will, which the whole world obeys,

verses.arabic: وَبِكَلِمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ خَلَقْتَ بِهَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضَ
verses.translation: by Your Word by which You have created the heavens and the earth,
by Your Wisdom with which You have created the wonderful things,
created darkness, made it night,
made night the time of quiet and rest,
created light, made it daylight,
made day the time of movement and observation,

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقْتَ بِهَا الشَّمْسَ وَجَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاۤءً،
verses.translation: created the sun, made the sun light,

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقْتَ بِهَا الْقَمَرَ وَجَعَلْتَ الْقَمَرَ نُورًا،
verses.translation: created the moon, made the moon of light,
created heavenly bodies,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهَا نُجُوْمًا وَبُرُوْجًا وَمَصَابِيْحَ وَزِيْنَةً وَ رُجُوْمًا،
verses.translation: made them fixed stars, planets, lamps for guidance at night, means of decoration, and missiles,
created for them east and west,
created for them places of ascendancy and orbits,
created for them a firmament and spheres,

verses.arabic: وَقَدَّرْتَهَا فِي السَّمَاۤءِ مَنَازِلَ فَاَحْسَنْتَ تَقْدِيْرَهَا،
verses.translation: fixed for them stages in the heaven withexcellent fixing,
shaped the stars withexcellent shaping,
measured them through Your Names withexact measurement,

verses.arabic: وَ دَبَّرْتَهَا بِحِكْمَتِكَ تَدْبِيْرًا وَاَحْسَنْتَ تَدْبِيْرَهَا،
verses.translation: designed through Your wisdom a system for them withexcellent design,
controlled the heavenly bodies through the influence of night and the influence of day,
and through hours, making them a means for the reckoning of years and counting,

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ رُؤْيَتَهَا لِجَمِيْعِ النَّاسِ مَرْئً وَاحِدًا،
verses.translation: and made all people see them alike.
I beseech You,O Allah, in the name of Your glory

verses.arabic: الَّذِيْ كَلَّمْتَ بِهِ عَبْدَكَ وَرَسُوْلَكَ مُوْسىٰ بْنَ عِمْرَانَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلَامُ فِى الْمُقَدَّسِيْنَ
verses.translation: with which You addressed Your servant and Messenger, Moses the son of 'Imran ('a) while he was in the company of angels;
an address even the favorite cherubim could not ever hear,
above the clouds of light,
above the box of evidence,

verses.arabic: فِيْ عَمُوْدِ النَّارِ وَ فِيْ طُوْرِ سَيْنَاۤءَ
verses.translation: within the pillar of fire on Mount Sinai
and on Mount Hurith
in the Holy Vale
in the sacred tract of land

verses.arabic: مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّوْرِ الْاَيْمَنِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ
verses.translation: to the right of Taurus Mountain through a tree,

verses.arabic: وَ فِيْ اَرْضِ مِصْرَ بِتِسْعِ اٰيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ
verses.translation: [and again addressed him] on the land of Egypt, after showing nine clear signs,

verses.arabic: وَ يَوْمَ فَرَقْتَ لِبَنِىْ اِسْرَاۤئِيْلَ الْبَحْرَ
verses.translation: and on the day You split the sea for the children of Israel,

verses.arabic: وَ فِيْ الْمُنْبَجِسَاتِ الَّتِىْ صَنَعْتَ بِهَا الْعَجَاۤئِبَ فِيْ بَحْرِ سُوْفِ
verses.translation: and caused springs to flow from a stone, thereby displaying wonders of Your might in a deep sea,

verses.arabic: وَ عَقَدْتَ مَاۤءَ الْبَحْرِ فِيْ قَلْبِ الْغَمْرِ كَالْحِجَارَةِ
verses.translation: on the day when You solidified the water of the sea in the midst of the storm,
caused the children of Israel to pass by the sea,

verses.arabic: وَ تَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُكَ الْحُسْنىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا
verses.translation: and fulfilled Your excellent promises made to them because of their calm endurance,

verses.arabic: وَ اَوْرَثْتَهُمْ مَشَارِقَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبِهَا الَّتِىْ بَارَكْتَ فِيْهَا لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ
verses.translation: made them the master of the East and the West in the earth wherein there are blessings for all the worlds,

verses.arabic: وَ اَغْرَقْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ جُنُوْدَهُ وَ مَرَاكِبَهُ فِيْ الْيَمِّ
verses.translation: drowned Pharaoh, his armies, and boats in the water.
[I beseech You] by Your Name, the great, the Most Great,
the Most Honorable, Most Majestic, and Most Noble,

verses.arabic: وَ بِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِىْ تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِمُوْسىٰ كَلِيْمِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِيْ طُوْرِ سَيْنَاۤءِ
verses.translation: and by Your Glory with which You revealed Yourself as light to Moses, Your addressee, peace be on him, on Mount Sinai,

verses.arabic: وَ لِاِبْرَاهِيْمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ خَلِيْلِكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فِىْ مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ
verses.translation: and earlier radiated the light for Abraham, Your sincere friend peace be on him, in the Mosque of al-Khif,

verses.arabic: وَ لِاِسْحَاقَ صَفِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِىْ بِئْرِ شِيَعِ
verses.translation: and for Isaac, Your chosen Prophet, peace be on him, in Shi' Well,

verses.arabic: وَ لِيَعْقُوْبَ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِىْ بَيْتِ اِيْلٍ
verses.translation: and for Your Prophet Jacob, peace be on him, in Bayt II,

verses.arabic: وَ اَوْفَيْتَ لِاِبْرَاهِيْمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِمِيْثَاقِكَ
verses.translation: and You fulfilled Your promise to Abraham, peace be on him,
Your oath in favor of Isaac,
Your witnessing favoring Jacob,
the fulfillments of Your promise to the faithful believers,
and Your Names with which You accepted the prayers of supplicants,

verses.arabic: وَ بِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِىْ ظَهَرَ لِمُوْسَى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَلىٰ قُبَّةِ الرُّمَّانِ
verses.translation: and by Your Glory, which appeared to Moses, the son of 'Imran, in al-Rumman Dome,

verses.arabic: وَ بِاٰيَاتِكَ الَّتِى وَقَعَتْ عَلىٰ اَرْضِ مِصْرَ
verses.translation: and by Your Signs, which appeared in the land of Egypt
with great might and victory,
with powerful signs,
with the display of full command,
great power,
the affair of the perfect word,

verses.arabic: وَ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ الَّتِى تَفَضَّلْتَ بِهَا عَلىٰ اَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ
verses.translation: and by Your words with which You do a favor to the inhabitants of the skies and the earth

verses.arabic: وَ اَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا وَ اَهْلِ الْاٰخِرَةِ
verses.translation: and the people of this world and the Next World,

verses.arabic: وَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِىْ مَنَنْتَ بِهَا عَلىٰ جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ
verses.translation: and by Your Mercy with which You bestow graces upon all Your creatures,

verses.arabic: وَ بِاسْتِطَاعَتِكَ الَّتِىْ اَقَمْتَ بِهَا عَلىٰ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
verses.translation: and by Your Power with which You dominate the worlds,

verses.arabic: وَ بِنُوْرِكَ الَّذِىْ قَدْ خَرَّ مِنْ فَزَعِهِ طُوْرُ سَيْنَاۤءَ
verses.translation: and by Your Light through fear of which Mount Sinai collapsed,

verses.arabic: وَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَ جَلَالِكَ وَ كِبْرِيَاۤئِكَ وَ عِزَّتِكَ
verses.translation: and by Your Knowledge, Majesty, Greatness, Honor,

verses.arabic: وَ جَبَرُوْتِكَ الَّتِىْ لَمْ تَسْتَقِلَّهَا الْاَرْضُ
verses.translation: and Might, which the earth could not bear,
the heavens bent down,
the great depths restrained themselves,

verses.arabic: وَ رَكَدَتْ لَهَا الْبِحَارُ وَ الْاَنْهارُ
verses.translation: oceans and rivers became stable,
mountains yielded,
the earth became firm on its shoulders,
all creatures surrendered,

verses.arabic: وَ خَفَقَتْ لَهَا الرِّيَاحُ فِى جَرَيَانِهَا
verses.translation: the winds breathed in their flow,

verses.arabic: وَ خَمَدَتْ لَهَا النِّيْرَانُ فِىْ اَوْطَانِهَا
verses.translation: and the flaming fires were extinguished in their places,

verses.arabic: وَ بِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِىْ عُرِفَتْ لَكَ بِهِ الْغَلَبَةُ دَهْرَ الدُّهُوْرِ
verses.translation: and by Your authority through which You are acknowledged to have All-powerfulness all the times

verses.arabic: وَ حُمِدْتَ بِهِ فِى السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرَضِيْنَ
verses.translation: and for which You are praised in the heavens and the earth,

verses.arabic: وَ بِكَلِمَتِكَ كَلِمَةِ الصِّدْقِ الَّتِىْ سَبَقَتْ لِاَبِيْنَا اٰدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ
verses.translation: and by Your word, the Word of Truth, which had became mercy for our father Adam and his offspring,

verses.arabic: وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِكَلِمَتِكَ الَّتِىْ غَلَبَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ
verses.translation: and by Your word that overcame everything,

verses.arabic: وَ بِنُوْرِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِىْ تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِلْجَبَلِ
verses.translation: and by the light of Your Face, which when You showed to the Mount,

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْتَهُ دَكًّا وَ خَرَّ مُوْسىٰ صَعِقًا
verses.translation: You caused it to crush into pieces, whereby Moses fainted and fell down,

verses.arabic: وَ بِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِىْ ظَهَرَ عَلىٰ طُوْرِ سَيْناۤءِ
verses.translation: and by Your Glory, which appeared on Mount Sinai,

verses.arabic: فَكَلَّمْتَ بِهِ عَبْدَكَ وَ رَسُوْلَكَ مُوْسَى بْنَ عِمْرَانَ
verses.translation: and through which You addressed Your servant and Messenger, Moses, the son of 'Imran,
and by Your appearance in Sa'ir,

verses.arabic: وَ ظُهُوْرِكَ فِىْ جَبَلِ فَارَانَ بِرَبَوَاتِ الْمُقَدَّسِيْنَ
verses.translation: and by Your appearance on Mount Faran on the heights of the holy ones,
When the troops of angels were in rows,
and with the submissiveness of the angels glorifying You,

verses.arabic: وَ بِبَرَكَاتِكَ الَّتِىْ بَارَكْتَ فِيْهَا عَلىٰ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ خَلِيْلِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
verses.translation: and by Your blessings by which You honored Abraham, Your sincere friend ('a)

verses.arabic: فِىْ اُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ
verses.translation: among the people of Muhammad, Your blessings be upon him and his household,
and You blessed Isaac, Your chosen prophet,
among the followers of Jesus, peace be on them both,
and You blessed Jacob, Your favored servant,
by including him among the followers of Moses, peace be on them both,

verses.arabic: وَ بَارَكْتَ لِحَبِيْبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ
verses.translation: and blessed Your intimate beloved, Muhammad, may the blessings of Allah be upon him and his Household,

verses.arabic: فِىْ عِتْرَتِهِ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَ اُمَّتِهِ
verses.translation: in his offspring, offspring, and people.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ كَمَا غِبْنَا عَنْ ذٰلِكَ وَ لَمْ نَشْهَدْهُ وَ اٰمَنَّا بِهِ وَ لَمْ نَرَهُ صِدْقًا وَ عَدْلًا
verses.translation: O Allah! Just as we were absent from that but we believe in it honestly and truly,

verses.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: So we beseech You to send Your benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْ تُبَارِكَ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: to bless Muhammad and the household of Muhammad,

verses.arabic: وَ تَرَحَّمَ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: and to have mercy on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

verses.arabic: كَاَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ وَ تَرَحَّمْتَ عَلىٰ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَ اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ
verses.translation: with the most auspicious benedictions, blessings, and mercy that You sent to Abraham and the posterity of Abraham.
Surely, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious,
and Doer of what You will.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْتَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ۔
verses.translation: You are Powerful over all things.
O Allah, in the name of this prayer
and in the name of these Names
which none knows their exegesis
or their implicit meanings save You,
(please) send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
do to me that of which You are worthy,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ،
verses.translation: do not do to me what I deserve,

verses.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِىْ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِىْ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ،
verses.translation: forgive my sins—past and future,
increase Your lawful sustenance for me,
and save me from the trouble of wicked men,
wicked neighbors,
wicked companions,
and wicked rules
Verily, You have power over all that You will to do
and You have full knowledge of all things.
Respond to me, O Lord of the worlds.

verses.arabic: يَا اَللهُ يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
verses.translation: O Allah! O All-tender! O Bestower!
O Fashioner of the heavens and the earth!
O Lord of Majesty and Honor!
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
(O Allah! I beseech You in the name of this prayer)...
and in the name of these Names
which none knows their exegesis
or their implicit meanings save You,
(please) send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
do to me that of which You are worthy,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ،
verses.translation: do not do to me what I deserve,

verses.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِىْ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِىْ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ،
verses.translation: forgive my sins—past and future,
increase Your lawful sustenance for me,
and save me from the trouble of wicked men,
wicked neighbors,
wicked companions,
and wicked rules
Verily, You have power over all that You will to do
and You have full knowledge of all things.
Respond to me, O Lord of the worlds.
O Allah! I beseech You in the name of this prayer
and in the name of these Names

verses.arabic: الَّتِىْ لَا يَعْلَمُ تَفْسِيْرَهَا وَ لَا تَأْوِيْلَهَا
verses.translation: which none knows their exegesis or interpretation

verses.arabic: وَ لَا بَاطِنَهَا وَ لَا ظَاهِرَهَا غَيْرُكَ
verses.translation: and none knows their implicit or explicit meanings save You,

verses.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: to send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

verses.arabic: وَ اَنْ تَرْزُقَنِىْ خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ
verses.translation: and to provide me with the good of this world and the Next World.

verses.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ
verses.translation: Do to me that of which You are worthy

verses.arabic: وَ لَا تَفْعَلْ بِىْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ
verses.translation: but do not do to me what I deserve,

verses.arabic: وَ انْتَقِمْ لِىْ مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانِ (اَعْدَاۤءِ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ)
verses.translation: and exact vengeance from... [so-and-so]

verses.arabic: وَ اغْفِرْ لِىْ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِى مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَ مَا تَاَخَّرَ
verses.translation: forgive my sins—past and future,

verses.arabic: وَ لِوَالِدَىَّ وَ لِجَمِيْعِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
verses.translation: forgive my parents and all faithful believers—men and women,

verses.arabic: وَ وَسِّعْ عَلَىَّ مِنْ حَلَالِ رِزْقِكَ
verses.translation: increase Your lawful sustenance for me,
save me from the troubles of wicked men,
wicked neighbors,
wicked rulers,
wicked companions,
evil days,
and evil hours,
and exact vengeance for me on everyone who hatches secret plots against me,
]on everyone who oppresses me,
seeks to do injustice to me, my wife,
my children, my brothers,
my neighbors, and my relatives
among faithful men and women
Verily, You have power to do whatever You will to do
and You have full knowledge of all things.
Respond to me, O Lord of the worlds.
O Allah! In the name of this prayer, I beseech You

verses.arabic: تَفَضَّلْ عَلىٰ فُقَرَاۤءِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالْغِنىٰ وَ الثَّرْوَةِ
verses.translation: to grant wealth and affluence to indigent faithful men and women,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلىٰ مَرْضَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالشِّفَاۤءِ وَ الصِّحَةِ
verses.translation: recovery and wellbeing to the sick faithful men and women,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلىٰ اَحْيَاۤءِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِاللُّطْفِ وَ الْكَرَامَةِ
verses.translation: bliss and clemency to the living faithful men and women,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلىٰ اَمْوَاتِ الْمُؤمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ وَ الرَّحْمَةِ
verses.translation: remit the sins of, and have mercy on, the deceased faithful men and women,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلىٰ مُسَافِرِى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالرَّدِّ اِلىٰ اَوْطَانِهِمْ سَالِمِيْنَ غَانِمِيْنَ
verses.translation: and arrange the return of all faithful travelers with safety and gain,
by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

verses.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَ عِتْرَتِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
verses.translation: May Allah send blessings to our master Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets, and upon his Household, the purified
and send peace upon them in abundant measure.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّى اَسْئَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ هٰذَا الدُّعَاۤءِ
verses.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the sacredness of this prayer,

verses.arabic: وَ بِمَا فَاتَ مِنْهُ مِنَ الْاَسْمَاۤءِ
verses.translation: the Names mentioned therein,

verses.arabic: وَ بِمَا يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ التَّفْسِيْرِ وَ التَّدْبِيْرِ
verses.translation: and the explanation and deep meanings of these names

verses.arabic: الَّذِىْ لَا يُحِيْطُ بِهِ اِلَّا اَنْتَ ۔۔۔۔
verses.translation: that none comprehends save You...
